source_text:
Alex Menon
Senior Embedded Engineer
Skills
Python - Advanced
Verilog - Proficient
SystemVerilog - Working
MATLAB - Working
LTspice - Proficient
Docker - Working
Git - Advanced
Experience
ABC Controls | Senior Embedded Engineer | Jan 2021 | Present
XYZ Robotics | Embedded Engineer | Jun 2018 | Dec 2020
Education
VIT Chennai | B.Tech | Electronics and Communication Engineering | 2018
Certifications
AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (2024) - AWS

Interviewer: Describe a challenging problem you solved.
Candidate: I designed the RTL architecture for the controller and implemented the interfaces in
SystemVerilog.
Interviewer: What measurable impact did you have?
Candidate: I reduced end-to-end latency by 40% after changing the buffering strategy.
Interviewer: Tell me about a failure.
Candidate: We had an outage caused by a memory leak. I identified the issue and led the fix,
then added monitoring and alerts.

Role: Embedded Systems Engineer
Summary: Build and validate embedded control firmware and digital logic for industrial products.
Required Skills
- C/C++ or Python
- Verilog or SystemVerilog / RTL fundamentals
- Debugging and test-driven engineering
- Linux and Git
Preferred Skills
- MATLAB or LTspice
- CI/CD and observability tooling
Responsibilities
- Design and validate digital control logic.
- Diagnose system failures using structured experiments.
- Collaborate with firmware, hardware, and test engineers.
- Document trade-offs and verification evidence.
Constraints
- Must contribute independently within the first 90 days.
- Role requires evidence of hands-on design depth.
